payload.reason: The re-ranking approach described in the paper operates on a set of pre-existing answer candidates and does not involve retraining the underlying QA system, which aligns with transductive learning principles.

claims.text: The re-ranking approach improves the performance of deployed QA systems without retraining, which is characteristic of transductive learning.
The method uses the top-10 candidates from the baseline QA system and adjusts their ranking based on additional similarity measures, typical of transductive techniques.
